the right strap continues straight up to her right breast, where the strap widens into a slim woven band of neon orange cable ties about one and a half fingers wide exactly where it passes over her right breast, fully and opaquely covering her right nipple and areola, then curving up over its shoulder as a strap a single cable tie wide and meeting the other strap behind her neck, these slim straps alone covering her chest and leaving the rest of her torso bare, every piece showing a matte ribbed plastic sheen and tidy rows of locking heads, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare between the rungs. Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
